acceptanceGates: Every downloaded reference file has source URL, license/rights decision, byte length and SHA-256.
Exterior references are classified by facade, approximate camera pose, date, and visible occlusion; unknown pose remains unknown.
Building dimensions are sourced to independent survey or clearly tagged published measurement with a tolerance and axis mapping.
Compound area is never substituted for building footprint or floor area.
Candidate GLB is tested by geometry QA, UV/texture QA, deterministic multi-view renders, and independent reference review.
No visual fidelity or release pass is inferred from a successful build or a valid GLB alone.
